items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Panama Francis had come in the band then... and I was on bass

ctx.x: I stayed… we went to the….as I said in traveling down South, things got a little bad because they didn‟t like us coming down with all those beautiful shows, Gal Of Mine, and great dancers, comedians and things. So that stopped, got cut out, and finances got small. So we come down to seven pieces where we could do small clubs in towns like Seattle, San Francisco, Chicago. Went down to seven pieces; Sam The Man Taylor, Panama Francis had come in the band then, Kay Johnson, trombone was still there, David Rivera was…

The first time I ever played with you I filled in for Dave. Dave was a neighbor of mine. We live in Riverton and he was a neighbor of mine and I don‟t know, somebody, I guess his wife… something happened suddenly and he called me, he said, “Look, bail me out. I can‟t do”… whatever it was, and I went down and played the show. It‟s the first time I played with you. Man, it‟s like riding in a Rolls Royce, I said all right

items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: And Dave Rivera David Baer played piano, and Milt Bill Hinton -- -- on bass, you Base and myself; that was the band.

ctx.x: And Dave Rivera David Baer played piano, and Milt Bill Hinton -- -- on bass, you Base and myself; that was the band.
And then Cab broke up the big band and went down to 7 pieces, didn't he?

items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, and Milt Hinton on bass and Cab Calloway. Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah. Now that 7 piece band was composed of Sam Taylor, Keg Ray Johnson and Jonah Jones. And you David and Francis on drums, and Dave Rivera on piano.
Yeah, and Milt Hinton on bass and Cab Calloway. Yeah.
We played all out in the west, too.

items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The most remarkable little Italian gentleman that just took care of everybody's instruments. He was beautiful. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah, he was just beautiful.

ctx.x: The most remarkable little Italian gentleman that just took care of everybody's instruments. He was beautiful.
Oh, yeah, he was just beautiful. He couldn't speak too much Engls, but he could sure take care of things.
